# Update Documentation Prompt

## Goal

Update scaffold documentation so it stays consistent with the repository's reusable engineering guidance.

## Requirements

- Keep documentation generic and reusable
- Update navigation when adding new scaffold assets
- Prefer instruction-oriented language
- Remove stale guidance when newer rules supersede it

## Output Shape

### Updated Docs
- List the updated files

### Summary
- What changed in the docs

### Validation
- What was checked after the update
